description: The Royal Botanic Gardens in Trinidad and Tobago is located in Port of Spain. The Gardens, which were established in 1818, are situated just north of the Queen's Park Savannah. This is one of the oldest Botanic Gardens in the world, and houses 700 species of trees, a butterfly garden, and a historic Governor's burial plot. . Listed opening hours: 6:00 am - 6:00 pm Daily.
